title: Fragmented handshake tally and quick econ probe
content:
Purpose: very small, fast slice to map who can cover short cross-team runtime handoffs for the upcoming weekend (June 20-21). Not meant to be full rota — just where to nudge and small-econ probe on potential burn if we ask for 2–4hr stretch contributions.

Quick summary:
- Coverage target: 6 cross-functional handoffs (SRE, Platform, SE, Product Ops) across 3 time windows (sat morning, sat evening, sun afternoon).
- Hard contacts: 9 people who said "can help 2 hrs" on sync (see rows below).
- Budget: aim to keep additional headcount burn < 12 engineer-hours total (prefer in-kind swaps).

Mini-table (quick rows, columns are informal):
- id | contact | team | best-window | max-hrs | note
- 1 | Rina Patel | product-ops | Sat morning (07-11 PT) | 2 | prefers async handoff; can stay on pager 1hr
- 2 | Samir Cheng | platform-eng | Sat evening (18-22 PT) | 3 | can do extended but not full weekend
- 3 | Liam O'Connor | sre | Sun afternoon (12-16 PT) | 2 | willing if rotated with another SRE
- 4 | Aisha Khan | solutions-eng | Sat morning | 1.5 | customer-facing handoff preferred
- 5 | Neha Rao | infra | Sat evening | 2 | can do on-call overlap
- 6 | Marcus Li | product-ops | Sun afternoon | 1 | backup only
- 7 | Priya Desai | serving-runtime | Sat evening | 2 | has firewall creds, good for triage
- 8 | Omar Aziz | observability | Sat morning | 1.5 | will run quick dashboards
- 9 | Elyse Tran | se | Sun afternoon | 2 | can handle customer concalls

Quick econ probe (ballpark):
- If we ask everyone above for their max-hrs: 15 hrs total. Target cap = 12 hrs. So ask for 0.8x of declared max on average.
- Cost proxy: assume blended fully-loaded eng rate $140/hr -> 12hrs = $1,680 incremental. Flag to finance if >$2k.

Operational notes / instructions for whoever runs the handoff:
- Primary: pair contact with documented route in ops-runbook stub (see linked confluence).
- If person drops: escalation order = Samir -> Priya -> Rina -> Elyse.
- Use #ops-weekend channel for live pings. Slack snippets: `/call-swap` and `/ops-tiling` templates in pinned messages.

Open questions / risks:
- Some folks listed availability but require manager ok (Samir noted needs a swap sign-off). Need to cc managers before final ask.
- Risk of burnout if we over-ask the product-ops crew; prefer 30–45min handoffs + async notes.
- If a live incident spans >3hrs, move to contingency paid surge (contact finance and on-call manager).

Action items (owner -> next step):
- Diego -> confirm manager approvals for Samir & Neha by EOD Thu (2026-06-18).
- Rina -> draft 3 short handoff checklists (monitor, escalate, customer thread) by Fri morning.
- Priya -> confirm firewall access matrix for Sat evening by Fri EOD.
- Observability (Omar) -> pre-bake 2 dashboards and share links in doc.

Notes to self (fragmented, keep for next iteration):
- Could convert to tiny sheet for live sign-up if more than 12 people volunteer.
- Consider rotating primary every 90 minutes instead of single 2hr block to reduce fatigue.
- Keep final ask concise: one sentence + one line explicit expected tasks.

End of probe. Save as working artifact; push to shared drive and ping list above once manager approvals captured.

Recent edits:
- 2026-06-16: added Marcus Li & Elyse entries after quick sync.
- 2026-06-17: updated econ calc and action items.

Unresolved links: check confluence page FRAG-coverage-scratch for runbook stubs (linked above).
